body.objective: Construct or exactly obstruct the smallest new Maxwell-cotangent q1-preimage mapping cone singled out by the complete existing-row temporal covariance no-go, then decide whether it supplies a same-action cyclic q2 repair.
body.stop_condition: Begin only after observer-post-temporal-antifield-module-disposition terminates and import its irreducible representation/minimal-enlargement theorem, plus BERGER_TEMPORAL_MAXWELL_EMITTER_ANTIFIELD_COVARIANCE_MODULE, by exact hashes. If it identifies a finite minimal mixed-bundle or higher-jet target, adjoin exactly the required q1 preimage of A-plus together with the Maxwell ghost-antifield differential, reducibility if present, signed cotangent descendants, nonminimal completion and odd pairing. Derive every q1 and q2 row from one local action; prove q1^2=0, the action Hessian identity, cyclicity, real structure and K_Berger covariance, and recompute the formerly rank-one covariance quotient for both emitters. Prove minimality by deleting each new irreducible block and by rejecting the old 2,048-action existing-row module as a negative control. If the disposition proves no finite target in the declared class, emit that exact obstruction instead of widening blindly. Stop before q3, detector/redshift promotion or branch interpretation unless the repaired arity-two quotient is exactly zero.
body.current_gate: minimal action-derived Maxwell-cotangent mapping cone after the representation theorem
body.forbid: no pull before the active disposition item terminates; no blind row enlargement; no source vector inserted without one action; no omission of ghost-antifield or signed cotangent descendants; no q3 or observer promotion from a nonzero arity-two quotient; no K_Berger/raw-D identification; no branch, particle, positivity, scattering or phenomenology claim
activates: one bounded same-action q3/relational-observable replay if the quotient closes
an explicit observer input for the selected compensator repair
body.resource_hint: OBSERVER OUTCOME-SAFE RESERVE. The resident one-lease rule prevents premature pull while the representation/disposition item remains active.
notes: The existing-row theorem has full rank 2613 and augmented rank 2614 for each emitter; it is the mandatory negative control.
The first unexcluded representation is a genuine q1 preimage of the Maxwell cotangent row, not another action column on the old carrier.
A complete minimality obstruction is a successful scientific result.
